dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: Hello there. Are you here to offer incense today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you give me a few sticks?

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: No problem. Please wait a moment...

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: Here, take them. The censer is right there, please go ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do many people come here to offer incense these days?

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: This place is a little off the beaten track, and few people know that there is a temple here at all.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: Hmm. Perhaps I should find some way to let people know this temple is here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you finished your book yet?

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: Not quite. Heh... well actually, to tell the truth, I'm still a long way off...

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: I did collect quite a fair bit of material, but some of the stories don't have enough evidence to back them up.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: I've spent goodness-knows how much time just trying to confirm which sources are reliable.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: So as for my book... *sigh* Even I don't know how much longer it'll take at this point.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: Alright. Stay safe, now. Be careful when you're out there. The roads are not that safe.
